entries.title: Reservation cutoff includes the closing minute
entries.root_cause: The reservation cutoff comparison accepts a request exactly at the closing minute, although the cutoff is exclusive. Change the comparison to exclude the closing minute.

entries.title: Reservation capacity ignores a cancellation
entries.root_cause: The available capacity calculation counts cancelled reservations as occupied. Exclude cancelled reservations from the occupied count.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same Jest suite reports a different assertion: available capacity after cancellation, rather than the exclusive closing-minute boundary.

entries.title: Jest cannot resolve the installed test environment
entries.root_cause: The Jest configuration selects jest-environment-jsdom but that package is absent from the project's dependencies. Add the matching jest-environment-jsdom package.
